title: Volvo FH16 Series 5 FUPS Compliant Custom Built High Tensile Aluminium Bullbar #46
description: Volvo FH16 Series 5 Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Dual Mini centre uprights Radar compliant and dual tow pins. Main channel incorporates factory fitted lights with custom built high tensile aluminium backing plate, weight saving = 80kg. Custom driving light mounts and indicator/parker combination light recessed in outer uprights.
